newsitem.title: USA: GPU sees 610 MW N.J. nuke back next week.
newsitem.headline: GPU sees 610 MW N.J. nuke back next week.

text.p: GPU Nuclear, a subsidiary of GPU Inc, said Thursday it expected its Oyster Creek nuclear power plant to resume service next week after being shut last Friday due to fluctuating levels of generator cooling water.
"We should be ready to restart by the beginning of next week," said an onsite GPU spokeswoman.
Technicians continued to replace electrical cables, which run to a system that operates on the plant's emergency diesel generators, she added.
The 610 MW Oyster Creek generating station is located in Forked River, N.J.
